summary: Iteration 7: verified /api/transcribe (whisper-1) endpoint and regression of the New Quote voice UX. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass (wav 200+text, webm suffix 200+text, empty file 400, missing file 422, plus regressions: /api/quotes, /api/company, /api/quotes/{id}/pdf, /api/quotes/{id}/send-email, public accept). Frontend /nouveau flow still shows voice-primary-button on step 1, 'Dicter la description' on step 2, and 'Modifier le devis à la voix' on step 3; keyboard entry works and analyze->step3 flow works.
critical_code_review_comments: useDictation.js: whisper fallback swallows errors silently (empty catch). Consider surfacing a toast/error state on transcribe fetch failure so users know the dictation failed.

Backend /api/transcribe writes UploadFile to a temp file and re-opens synchronously; file.read() is awaited but the temp write is sync - fine for small clips, but consider a size cap (e.g. 25MB Whisper limit) with 413 to avoid abuse.
server.py is ~1260 lines - splitting into routers (quotes, voice, email, pdf) would improve maintainability per the code-review guideline (>700 lines).
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed called before and after tests to reset demo data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 adds POST /api/transcribe using emergentintegrations OpenAISpeechToText(whisper-1). Test with tests/test_iter7.py which generates a small WAV via python's wave module. Real MediaRecorder cannot be driven headless, so only verify the endpoint and that the voice UX buttons (voice-primary-button, 'Dicter la description', 'Modifier le devis à la voix') still render on /nouveau.
